notes: Edit freely (Fight settings > Edit…). Times are seconds after the pull. timesFrom: bigwigs = timeline durations read from BigWigs (pull timers only), guide = from the guide, assumed = my guess. 'assumed' lists effect sizes that are guesses. BigWigs matches timeline bars by rounded duration: Abyssal Rain 8/23/33, Alluring Bubble 18, bubble adds 7/25, Chilling Frost 17/35, Swirling Whirlpools 89/107, plus a 44 s bar that rotates adds -> Chilling Frost -> Abyssal Rain; read here as pull timers 25 (adds), 35 (frost), 107 (whirlpools), each repeating every 3 x 44 = 132 s (assumed). Not modelled: Abyssal Rain and Pop! (raid damage), Wavecaller's Might stacks and Unending Tides (enrage), Iceblade Flurry / Water Jet (tank), failed murlocs turning into Berserkers.
